description.en: Contain-mints stun all zombies on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Contain-mint Family plants on the lawn.
description.zh: 滞缓薄荷在种植时眩晕全场的僵尸，并为所有滞缓家族植物带来增益效果。

chat.en: "Go easy, there," says Contain-mint. "No need to be in such a rush all the time. Movement is totally overrated."
chat.zh: “放轻松，别着急，”滞缓薄荷说道。“没必要总是这么赶，行动什么的，完全被高估了。”
